seo.description: Frequently asked questions about ordering, delivery, revisions and payment.

hero.title: Frequently asked questions
hero.text: Quick answers about working with me.

items.q: How do I place an order?
items.a: Message me on WhatsApp or use the contact form. Tell me what you need and I will send you a quote.
Yes. All design and data work is done remotely and delivered online.
Yes. Vector portraits and some other services are also available on my Fiverr profile, @arafatwahahid.
Most small jobs are delivered in 1 to 3 days. Bigger projects get a delivery date in the quote.

items.q: How many revisions do I get?
items.a: Each service page lists its revisions. Vector portraits come with unlimited revisions.

items.q: What file formats do you deliver?
items.a: Design work comes as PNG, JPG, PDF and source files (AI or PSD) when agreed. Excel work comes as .xlsx.
Payment methods are confirmed when you order. Fiverr orders are paid through Fiverr.
Please read the refund and return policy page for details.
